component: Human reference annotation staffing (candidate record, no identities supplied)
staffing_mode_note: Required by the locked protocol for any reliability claim: two independent primary annotators plus a separate adjudicator. SINGLE_ANNOTATOR mode is not proposed here.
identities_supplied_note: No annotator has been named. Every identity and acknowledgement slot below is null until the owner supplies it. Nothing in this record may be filled by a model or by Claude Code.

personal_data_policy.record_contains: stable reviewer aliases and yes/no acknowledgements only
record_must_not_contain: legal or full names (unless the owner deliberately chooses a name as the alias)
personal_data_policy.alias_to_person_mapping_location: kept by the owner outside the repository

alias_rules: Each alias is a stable, non-empty string used unchanged in every staffing, annotation, and adjudication record.
The three aliases are pairwise distinct after strip and casefold (for example R1 and r1 are the same reviewer). Normalization is for comparison only; the alias is stored as given.
A primary alias must not equal, or be a case or spacing variant of, PROJECT_OWNER or CLAUDE_CODE_ASSISTED_DRAFTING.

If the project owner serves in any role, that role's alias is exactly PROJECT_OWNER, so the readiness check compares the same string recorded as an Arm A author. No other alias (for example 'owner', 'PROJECT-OWNER', or a personal name) may stand in for the owner.

relationship_to_project is declared truthfully. A role whose relationship_to_project is PROJECT_OWNER has the alias exactly PROJECT_OWNER, and only that role may use it. The readiness code does not infer real-world identity.
CLAUDE_CODE_ASSISTED_DRAFTING is not a human and may not fill any role.

intended_research_configuration.label: PREFERRED, not a locked requirement. If the owner adjudicates, the alias is PROJECT_OWNER and the departure is disclosed in every report.

field_values.relationship_to_project: One of: NONE, PROJECT_OWNER, OTHER_DISCLOSED (with a short description in conflict_disclosure). No employer or organization names.
field_values.conflict_disclosure: Short text, or the string NONE. Never null at freeze.
field_values.booleans: true or false as stated by the reviewer and confirmed by the owner. Null means not yet obtained.

freeze_conditions: All three stable_reviewer_alias values are filled, pairwise distinct after strip and casefold, and follow alias_rules.
human_confirmed is true for all three roles.
relationship_to_project is declared truthfully for all three roles, and any role declared PROJECT_OWNER uses exactly the alias PROJECT_OWNER.

For primary_a and primary_b: relationship_to_project is not PROJECT_OWNER, arm_a_supplement_author_or_approver is false, prior_access_to_model_annotations_or_results is false, and no_coordination_acknowledged is true.

For all three roles: protocol_acknowledged, calibration_requirement_acknowledged, blinding_acknowledged, and no_automated_labelling_acknowledged are true; conflict_disclosure is filled; acknowledgement_date is filled.

authored_stage_b_e_f_corpus_or_protocol and seen_stage_e_fixture_annotations are recorded as given. They are reported, not hidden (protocol section 2), and are not by themselves disqualifying under the locked protocol.
The owner approves the filled record and it is frozen before any pilot and before any main experimental result is viewed.
no_qualification_threshold_note: The locked design defines no annotator qualification score, certification, or statistical entry threshold. Calibration (protocol section 5) is completed after staffing and before evaluation packets; its labels and agreement are not reported as reliability results and are not a pass/fail gate created here.

primary_annotators_must_not_access: model-labelled Stage D outcomes (D_model) or any Stage D reason code
model identity, prompt, or sampling settings
Stage E fixture annotations or oracle outcomes
adjudicator_may_receive: the blinded source packet produced by the unchanged packet builder
both primary annotation records (H attestations, statuses, field values, notes)
adjudicator_must_not_receive: model-labelled Stage D result (D_model) or any Stage D reason code

enforcement.packet_contents: Enforced by the locked build_annotation_packet (unchanged): it takes only an artifact and its context, drops model annotations, and replaces model segment ids with opaque ids.
enforcement.everything_else: Operational. The packet operator and owner must keep the other materials away from annotators; no code in this repository enforces access to files, results, or conversations.

author_independence_mapping.readiness_function: experiments/engine3_stage_f/readiness.py check_pilot_readiness, as amended by HARNESS_AMENDMENT_001 (docs/engine3/ENGINE3_STAGE_F_HARNESS_AMENDMENT_001.md)
author_independence_mapping.staffing_input: AnnotatorStaffing(primary_a_alias, primary_b_alias, adjudicator_alias, frozen=True) from the frozen O-3 record
author_independence_mapping.supplement_input: 16 SupplementArtifact values from the O-6 frozen file and manifest, author_aliases = (CLAUDE_CODE_ASSISTED_DRAFTING, PROJECT_OWNER)
author_independence_mapping.alias_normalization: strip surrounding whitespace, then casefold; exact equality after normalization; no substring or fuzzy matching
author_independence_mapping.rule: an artifact fails author independence if either normalized primary alias equals any of its normalized author aliases
code_enforces: three pairwise distinct aliases after strip and casefold (HARNESS_AMENDMENT_001)
neither primary alias equals an author alias of any supplement artifact, after strip and casefold
author independence is reported as not checkable when either primary alias is empty
code_does_not_enforce: that any alias belongs to a human
real-world identity behind an alias: the owner is detected only if recorded under PROJECT_OWNER (or a case or spacing variant)
adjudicator independence from authors (preferred research configuration, not a hard rule)
any acknowledgement, disclosure, or blinding condition
author_independence_mapping.record_governance: If the project owner serves in any reviewer role, the alias is exactly PROJECT_OWNER. This is a declared-record condition checked at owner review; the code does not infer identity from an arbitrary alias.
author_independence_mapping.previous_gap: Before HARNESS_AMENDMENT_001 the locked check failed an artifact only when both primaries were authors, so one author as one primary, and case or spacing variants, passed.

o5_note: No model family, model version, prompt, sampling configuration, or experiment configuration is chosen or implied by this record.
claim_boundary: A staffing candidate record only. It names no one, resolves no pre-run item, authorizes no pilot or live run, and is not evidence of annotation reliability, semantic validation, purchase prediction, sales lift, production security, or BAEC theory.
